tagline.zh: 写剧本 → 排分镜 → 生成素材 → 预览成片素材，一套装齐
tagline.en: Script → storyboard → generate assets → preview them, installed in one go

tagline.zh: 让 Agent 生成图片、视频、音乐和播客，并把语音转成文字
tagline.en: Let the agent generate images, video, music and podcasts, and transcribe speech

zh: 生成图片；带参考图时可改图、换风格
生成视频（后台运行，一般 1–10 分钟）
生成音乐（可自带歌词）或一期播客
把语音转成文字（目前只支持普通话）
查看可用模型、价格、任务和账号
en: Generate images; edit or restyle with reference images
Generate video (runs in the background, usually 1-10 minutes)
Generate music (with your own lyrics) or a podcast episode
Transcribe speech to text (Mandarin only for now)
List available models, prices, tasks and the signed-in account

text.zh: 提示词和参考素材会发送到 VibeDev 网关，再转交模型服务商
text.en: Prompts and reference media are sent to the VibeDev gateway, which forwards them to the model provider

text.zh: 生成结果保存在工作区的 media/ 目录
text.en: Results are saved under media/ in the workspace

text.zh: 使用 VibeDev 登录账号；在 VibeDev 里无需再登录
text.en: Uses your VibeDev sign-in; no second login inside VibeDev

text.zh: 图片按张、视频按秒、音乐和播客按次计费；视频和音频失败不扣费，提交后的视频无法取消
text.en: Images per image, video per second, music and podcasts per request; failed video/audio is not charged and a submitted video cannot be cancelled

tagline.zh: 在右侧栏写剧本、排分镜、调度导演台，Agent 用影视工具协同改片
tagline.en: Write the script, board the shots and run the director desk in the right sidebar, with film tools for the agent

zh: 剧本标签：Markdown 剧本，每次写入有版本记录，可单独撤回某次操作
分镜画布：节点式画布，可生成图片和视频（需要「VibeDev 媒体生成」）
导演台：在 3D 场景里调度人物与机位
Agent 影视工具 30 个，另带编剧技能 /film-screenwriting
en: Script tab: Markdown screenplay with a version record for every write; any single operation can be reverted
Storyboard canvas: node-based canvas that can generate images and video (needs VibeDev Media)
Director desk: stage characters and cameras in a 3D scene
30 film tools for the agent, plus the /film-screenwriting skill

text.zh: 项目是工作区 film/ 下的普通文件；升级和卸载插件不会改动它们
text.en: A project is plain files under film/ in the workspace; upgrading or removing the plugin does not touch them

text.zh: 为有影片的会话增加影视工具和说明，会占用部分上下文
text.en: Adds film tools and guidance to sessions with a film, using part of the context

tagline.zh: 在右侧栏直接预览视频、音频和 HTML，并按文件夹浏览媒体画廊
tagline.en: Preview video, audio and HTML right in the sidebar, and browse a folder as a media gallery

zh: 视频：可拖进度条、倍速、循环，不限文件大小
音频：实时频谱、倍速、循环
HTML：默认允许脚本，在隔离沙箱里运行；可看源码、切换手机/平板/桌面宽度
媒体画廊：缩略图、按类型筛选、搜索、灯箱浏览
en: Video: seekable, speed control, loop, no file-size cap
Audio: live spectrum, speed control, loop
HTML: scripts allowed by default, inside an isolated sandbox; view source, switch phone/tablet/desktop width
Media gallery: thumbnails, type filters, search, lightbox

text.zh: 只读取当前会话工作目录内的文件
text.en: Reads only files inside the current session's working directory

text.zh: 在本机服务上增加 /mp 路由，仅回环地址可访问
text.en: Adds /mp routes to the local server, reachable from loopback only

text.zh: HTML 预览默认允许脚本，运行在无法访问界面的隔离沙箱中
text.en: HTML preview allows scripts by default, inside a sandbox that cannot reach the UI

tagline.zh: 文件树、编辑器、变更和侧边对话合在右侧一栏，也是「媒体预览」的前置依赖
tagline.en: File tree, editor, changes and side chat in one right column; also the prerequisite of Media Viewer

zh: 把文件树、文本编辑器、Git 变更、任务和侧边对话放进右侧栏
让其他插件注册新的右侧栏标签页和文件预览器
en: Puts the file tree, text editor, Git changes, tasks and side chat in the right column
Lets other plugins register new sidebar tabs and file viewers

text.zh: 由 omdsh-dev 维护，本中心不审查其代码
text.en: Maintained by omdsh-dev; this center does not review its code

text.zh: 其 README 说明：文件接口不限制在工作区内，可访问你的用户有权限的任意路径
text.en: Its README states the file routes are not confined to the workspace and can reach any path your user can

why.zh: 在 VibeDev Next 里已能正常加载（本机观察，未做系统测试）
why.en: Loads fine in VibeDev Next (observed locally; not systematically tested)

tagline.zh: 浏览、搜索并一键安装社区里的插件，也能管理更新和停用
tagline.en: Browse, search and one-click install community plugins; also manages updates and disabling

zh: 浏览和搜索社区插件目录（数据来自 awesome-dsh-plugin）
一键安装、更新、停用和卸载；多数插件刷新页面即可用
插件分组与备注、备份与恢复插件清单、主题一键切换
en: Browse and search the community catalog (data from awesome-dsh-plugin)
One-click install, update, disable and uninstall; most plugins work after a page reload
Plugin groups and notes, backup/restore of the plugin list, one-click themes

text.zh: 读取公共插件目录，并通过 pnpm 下载安装插件
text.en: Reads the public plugin catalog and downloads plugins through pnpm

text.zh: 安装、启用、停用会修改你的插件配置文件
text.en: Installing, enabling and disabling modify your plugin configuration

text.zh: 由 dsh-market 团队维护（MIT），本中心不审查其代码；其 README 声明不向任何地方上报数据
text.en: Maintained by the dsh-market team (MIT); this center does not review its code; its README states it reports no data anywhere

why.zh: 在 VibeDev Next 里已能正常加载（本机观察，未做系统测试）
why.en: Loads fine in VibeDev Next (observed locally; not systematically tested)
